structured_output.title: Default CertificateRequest revisionHistoryLimit changes to 1 on upgrade
structured_output.content: The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the installed CRD certificates.cert-manager.io [v1], so Certificates here produce CertificateRequest revisions. The release note says the default `revisionHistoryLimit` for CertificateRequest revisions is now 1. The values keys set do not include any revision history setting, and the Certificate manifests' spec contents are not shown. Inspect whether any Certificate sets `spec.revisionHistoryLimit` explicitly, and whether anything relies on keeping older CertificateRequests for auditing or debugging.
